text:
To depart

in body and soul

to depart.


To depart

to rid oneself of gazes,

oppressive stones

sleeping in the throat.


I must depart

no more inertia beneath the sun

no more stunned blood

no more lining up to die.


I must depart


But charge on, traveler!

translation.title: The Last Innocence
translation.editorial_note: Partir is rendered as depart to keep both physical leaving and existential rupture.
